source.title: Valen - Roving Swordsman
source.name: Valen
source.description: A Warrior who is skilled at dealing AoE damage and becomes stronger under his enhanced mode.

skills.name: Thunder Swordwork

description.raw: Valen selects a tile and launches 7 Swift Strikes at the selected tile and its adjacent tiles. Each strike deals 70% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage to all targets. Valen is invincible while striking. After striking, Valen gains Invigoration for 12s, increasing his ATK by 20%.
active: Valen selects a tile and launches 7 Swift Strikes at the selected tile and its adjacent tiles.
Each strike deals 70% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage to all targets.
After striking, Valen gains Invigoration for 12s, increasing his ATK by 20%.

skills.description_lite: Valen launches several strikes within range and gains Invigoration.

skills.name: Unseen Blade

description.raw: Valen strikes the target 3 times. Each strike deals 100% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage. During Invigoration, Valen generates forked lightning with each strike, dealing equal damage to the target and up to 2 nearby enemies within 2 tiles.
active: During Invigoration, Valen generates forked lightning with each strike, dealing equal damage to the target and up to 2 nearby enemies within 2 tiles.

skills.description_lite: Valen strikes the enemy 3 times and deals chain damage to other enemies during Invigoration.

skills.name: Fury Thunder Strike

description.raw: Valen casts his lightning strike only when he gains Invigoration, dealing 190% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to all enemies within 2 tiles.
active: Valen casts his lightning strike only when he gains Invigoration, dealing 190% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to all enemies within 2 tiles.

skills.description_lite: Valen casts lightning strike only when he gains Invigoration, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Eternal Thunder

description.raw: Valen gains permanent Invigoration. When casting Thunder Swordwork during Invigoration, he permanently gains 10% ATK bonus, up to 10 stacks.
active: When casting Thunder Swordwork during Invigoration, he permanently gains 10% ATK bonus, up to 10 stacks.

text: Increases each stack of ATK bonus to 12%.
Triggers a lightning strike during a normal attack after gaining Invigoration, dealing equal amount of normal attack damage to an enemy within 2 tiles.
Increases each stack of ATK bonus to 13%.

skills.description_lite: Valen gains permanent Invigoration and increasing ATK bonus.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Valen inflicts a 3s stun with his Fury Thunder Strike.
active: Valen inflicts a 3s stun with his Fury Thunder Strike.

skills.description_lite: Valen stuns the enemy with Fury Thunder Strike.
